title: AT&T breakup testimony before Judge Greene

tellings.quote: AT&T hired me as the final witness

plain: Harold Malmgren, a former presidential advisor and trade official, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in the early 1980s the phone company AT&T hired him as its final witness in the government case that broke the company up, heard in Washington by Judge Harold Greene. He tells it to show how close he stood to major decisions, which supports his claim to have handled UFO material directly.
